about: Historical windows whose outcomes have been read by an evaluation (test / final / holdout). They may be re-run for reproduction but must not be used to select models, rules or parameters in the same scope. Maintained with tradelab/research/consumed.py. Development and validation windows of the same studies were also examined; they are listed where they were used for selection.

entries.note: All three P1 phases read outcomes; daily and weekly horizons, Coinbase USD point-in-time universe, price/volume features. The whole span is consumed for cross-sectional coin selection.
Rotation, breakout, mean reversion, calendar, gate on daily Coinbase data; earlier years used for development.
BTC/ETH/SOL 5-minute bars; holdout coins also evaluated over the same dates.
